combinations.magnitude: 83% inhibition combined vs 10% HRW and 32% JWH-133
combinations.evidence_quote: Specifically, the combined treatment achieved an 83% inhibition of the mechanical allodynia, in contrast with the 10% and 32% inhibition of HRW and JWH-133 given alone, respectively (Figure 4A).

combinations.magnitude: 65% inhibition combined vs 34% HRW and 45% JWH-133
combinations.evidence_quote: Similar effects were observed for thermal hyperalgesia with values of 65%, 34%, and 45% of inhibition and for cold allodynia with values of 74%, 38%, and 35% inhibition induced by HRW and JWH-133 combined and by HRW and JWH-133 administered individually, respectively (Figure 4B,C).

combinations.magnitude: 93% inhibition combined vs 10% HRW and 43% pregabalin
combinations.evidence_quote: The combined treatment achieved 93% inhibition of mechanical allodynia, in contrast with 10% for HRW or 43% for PGB alone (Figure 5A).

combinations.magnitude: 70% inhibition combined vs 34% HRW and 37% pregabalin
combinations.evidence_quote: For thermal hyperalgesia values of 70%, 34%, and 37% (Figure 5B) and for cold allodynia values of 78%, 38%, and 29% of inhibition induced by HRW and pregabalin combined and by HRW and pregabalin given alone were obtained (Figure 5C).
